def transform(grid):
    # At each row, fill the midpoint of horizontally adjacent zeros two columns apart.
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1,len(row)-1):
            if row[c] != 0 and row[c-1] == 0 and row[c+1] == 0:
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
PY
